sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No repair required; the candidate faithfully encodes the conditional capacity formula, accessibility requirement, storage-location evidence, authoritative ship target, datatypes, and metre unit.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: In the true applicability branch, add the supplied nltl:storageDistanceToMusterOrEmbarkation storage-location evidence required by the canonical variables and source obligation. Constrain it on the ship as a qudt:QuantityValue with the registered metre unit and numeric value structure, while retaining storageAccessibilityStatus=true; do not invent a distance threshold for the qualitative 'as close as practical' requirement.
